# `global_bursts`

the global bursts of a band from the cortex (the largest |z| over the spatial tiles per time tile) and the extents of each burst on the cells.

Version 2, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run global_bursts --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run global_bursts --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run select_dyadic_surface --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --surface cortex --finest "20 mm"
nxr-neuro run select_time_grid      --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest
nxr-neuro run global_bursts --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --spatial-scale "wavelength 40 mm" --band "8-16 Hz" --all [--groups pieces --combine each]
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `bursts_field` | field source estimate, chain cortical_band, chain_parameters {"recording": "{recording}", "kernel": "$kernel", "method": "$method", "band": "$band", "shape": "$shape", "spatial_scale": "$spatial_scale", "spatial_shape": "$spatial_shape", "transform": "$transform", "envelope": "$envelope", "modes": "$modes", "order": "$order", "tolerance": "$tolerance"} (composed in: the band on the cortex (the chain `cortical_band`)) | yes |
| `product` | selection any, where {"name": "$product"} (the product of the spatial tiles at the spatial scale and the time tiles of the band (`nxr-neuro run select_product` first)) | yes |
| `sample_product` | selection any, where {"name": "$sample_product"} (the product of the spatial tiles and the line's one-sample time grid (`nxr-neuro run select_product` with the grid made by `select_time_grid --rule tiles --duration <one sample>`)) | yes |
| `grid` | selection any, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording} time grid band ${band}"} (the band's time grid (`nxr-neuro run select_time_grid --rule band --band 8-16Hz` first)) | yes |
| `bad` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording}_bad_segments"}, required false | no |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `kernel` | `--kernel` | `none` | - |  | the inverse kernel's name, or none: found by `method` (the named kernel must also be of that method: --method) |
| `method` | `--method` | `MNE` | - |  | the kernel's inverse method (its params.inverse.measure) |
| `surface` | `--surface` | none | - |  | the cortex the kernel maps onto, by name (the surface of record or the glued surface) |
| `sample_product` | `--sample-product` | none | - |  | the product of the spatial tiles and the one-sample time grid, by name: the per-sample series the bursts' edges are fitted on |
| `product` | `--product` | none | - |  | the product selection (spatial tiles x time tiles) the cells are, by name |
| `band` | `--band` | `8-16 Hz` | Hz |  | the band as a quantity (its time level is resolved from it) |
| `shape` | `--shape` | `morlet` | - |  | the temporal band's shape: morlet \| meyer (compact edges: bands that add up) |
| `spatial_shape` | `--spatial-shape` | `mexhat` | - |  | the spatial band's gain: mexhat \| meyer (the scale IS its Weyl band: compact edges) |
| `spatial_scale` | `--spatial-scale` | none | mm |  | the spatial band as a quantity: a tile diameter (20 mm), a wavelength (wavelength 40 mm), an eigenvalue or a named scale; its Weyl band is the spatial band, its tiles the spatial partition |
| `groups` | `--groups` | `whole` | - | whole, pieces | whole \| pieces: the max over all the spatial tiles, or over each connected piece's (a hemisphere: the roll-up's target); pieces needs `combine: each` |
| `combine` | `--combine` | `mean` | - |  | the detection's series: mean (one global trace: GLOBAL events, no row) \| each (a trace a group: with per_hemisphere, each event carries its hemisphere); per_hemisphere needs `each` |
| `transform` | `--transform` | `auto` | - |  | the spatial band's route: auto = the stored eigenmodes when they reach the scale's band, else computed and stored (said), else chebyshev (announced) \| eigen \| chebyshev \| exact (dense, at most 4096 vertices) |
| `envelope` | `--envelope` | `temporal` | - |  | the spatial amplitude: temporal = \|z\| of the band-passed field \| spatiotemporal = the monogenic amplitude (another recipe: a rerun of the other envelope needs --replace) |
| `modes` | `--modes` | `0` | modes |  | when the eigenmodes are computed: the package's size; 0: the standard 3000, or more when the scale needs it |
| `order` | `--order` | `0` | degree |  | chebyshev degree; 0: the smallest of 40 to 5120 within `tolerance` of the band's gain |
| `tolerance` | `--tolerance` | `0.01` | fraction |  | the largest difference between the band's gain and the chebyshev series that is accepted |
| `bad_segments` | `--bad-segments` | `exclude` | - |  | exclude \| ignore the recording's bad spans |
| `enter_sd` | `--enter-sd` | `1.5` | robust SD |  | Rheome's labelalpha (as band_bursts) |
| `exit_sd` | `--exit-sd` | `1.0` | robust SD |  | robust SDs above the median to extend a burst (Rheome's loSD) |
| `merge_s` | `--merge-s` | `0.1` | s |  | gaps up to this are joined (Rheome's labelalpha, the default); with durations cycles, merge_cycles is used instead |
| `merge_cycles` | `--merge-cycles` | `1.0` | cycles |  | durations cycles: gaps up to this many cycles of the band's centre are joined (the nxr spindle_envelope) |
| `min_s` | `--min-s` | `0.4` | s |  | the bursts kept are at least this long |
| `max_s` | `--max-s` | none | s |  | the bursts kept are at most this long; null: no upper bound |
| `min_cycles` | `--min-cycles` | `3.0` | cycles |  | durations cycles: the bursts kept are at least this many cycles of the band's centre |
| `max_cycles` | `--max-cycles` | none | cycles |  | durations cycles: at most this many cycles; null: no upper bound |
| `durations` | `--durations` | `seconds` | - | seconds, cycles | seconds (merge_s, min_s, max_s) \| cycles (merge_cycles, min_cycles, max_cycles, of the band's centre) |
| `burst_summaries` | `--burst-summaries` | `["count", "sum", "median", "mean", "sd", "percentile:25", "percentile:75", "percentile:90"]` | - |  | the statistics across the bursts, per measurement |
| `extent_enter_sd` | `--extent-enter-sd` | `1.5` | robust SD |  | the extent's hysteresis on z = (cell amplitude - the tile's median) / the tile's robust SD (as the bursts') |
| `extent_exit_sd` | `--extent-exit-sd` | `1.0` | robust SD |  | the extent's lower hysteresis threshold |
| `model` | `--model` | `linear` | - |  | risefall: linear \| quadrature (the posterior model is not built) |
| `margin` | `--margin` | `1.0` | s |  | risefall: seconds either side of a burst included in its fit |
| `smooth` | `--smooth` | `0.1` | s |  | risefall: the symmetric moving mean applied first |
| `tau_max` | `--tau-max` | `1.0` | s |  | risefall: the bound of the rise and fall times |
| `min_r2` | `--min-r2` | none | - |  | risefall: a fit below it is set NaN; null keeps every fit (the caller filters on fit_r2) |
| `margin_cycles` | `--margin-cycles` | `10.0` | cycles |  | durations cycles: risefall's margin in cycles of the band's centre (nxr burst_stages) |
| `smooth_cycles` | `--smooth-cycles` | `1.0` | cycles |  | durations cycles: risefall's smoothing in cycles |
| `tau_max_cycles` | `--tau-max-cycles` | `10.0` | cycles |  | durations cycles: the bound of the rise and fall times in cycles |
| `gate_min_r2` | `--gate-min-r2` | `0.7` | - |  | the fit gate (nxr burst_stages, labelalpha's): a burst is kept when its fit has r2 at least this and neither time at its bound |
| `min_area` | `--min-area` | `0.0` | m2 |  | an event's cells' tiles cover at least this area (m2); 0: none |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.field_form`](../nodes.md) | x=bursts_field | form=magnitude | mag |
| chunks over `recording` | [`measurement.reduce`](../nodes.md) | x=mag, over=product, exclude=bad | measures=["amplitude", "envelope_max"], bad_segments=$bad_segments | cells, cells_ingredients |
| chunks over `recording` | [`measurement.reduce`](../nodes.md) | x=mag, over=sample_product, exclude=bad | measures=["amplitude"], bad_segments=$bad_segments | sample_cells, sample_cells_ingredients |
| after | [`measurement.roll_up`](../nodes.md) | x=cells_ingredients | to=$groups, measures=["envelope_max"] | trace_cells, trace_cells_ingredients |
| after | [`measurement.summarize`](../nodes.md) | x=trace_cells | summaries=["median", "mad"], combine=$combine | baseline |
| after | [`select.events.spans`](../nodes.md) | x=trace_cells, baseline=baseline | rule=detect, combine=$combine, enter_sd=$enter_sd, exit_sd=$exit_sd, merge_s=$merge_s, min_s=$min_s, max_s=$max_s, durations=$durations, merge_cycles=$merge_cycles, min_cycles=$min_cycles, max_cycles=$max_cycles | bursts |
| after | [`measurement.roll_up`](../nodes.md) | x=sample_cells_ingredients | to=$groups, measures=["amplitude"], merge=max | samples, samples_ingredients |
| after | [`select.risefall`](../nodes.md) | x=samples, events=bursts | model=$model, margin=$margin, smooth=$smooth, tau_max=$tau_max, min_r2=$min_r2, durations=$durations, margin_cycles=$margin_cycles, smooth_cycles=$smooth_cycles, tau_max_cycles=$tau_max_cycles | t_on, t_off, tau_rise, tau_fall, fit_baseline, fit_height, fit_r2, plateau_duration |
| after | [`select.events.spans`](../nodes.md) | events=bursts, fit_r2=fit_r2 | rule=keep_where, min_r2=$gate_min_r2 | bursts_kept |
| after | [`select.events.spans`](../nodes.md) | events=bursts, t_on=t_on, t_off=t_off, tau_rise=tau_rise, tau_fall=tau_fall, kept=bursts_kept | rule=stages | burst_onset, burst_within, burst_offset |
| after | [`measurement.summarize`](../nodes.md) | x=tau_rise | summaries=$burst_summaries, combine=each | tau_rise_stats |
| after | [`measurement.summarize`](../nodes.md) | x=tau_fall | summaries=$burst_summaries, combine=each | tau_fall_stats |
| after | [`measurement.summarize`](../nodes.md) | x=fit_r2 | summaries=$burst_summaries, combine=each | fit_r2_stats |
| after | [`measurement.reduce_members`](../nodes.md) | x=trace_cells_ingredients, over=bursts | measures=["amplitude", "envelope_max", "duration", "interval_next"] | burst_values, burst_values_ingredients |
| after | [`measurement.summarize`](../nodes.md) | x=burst_values | summaries=$burst_summaries, combine=each | burst_stats |
| after | [`measurement.summarize`](../nodes.md) | x=cells | summaries=["median", "mad"], combine=each, measure=amplitude, by_factor=0 | cell_baseline |
| after | [`select.events.regions`](../nodes.md) | x=cells, baseline=cell_baseline, events=bursts | enter_sd=$extent_enter_sd, exit_sd=$extent_exit_sd, min_area=$min_area | extents |
| after | [`measurement.reduce_members`](../nodes.md) | x=cells_ingredients, over=extents | measures=["n_cells", "n_tiles", "area", "amplitude", "envelope_max", "first_cell", "last_cell", "duration", "path_length", "centre"] | extent_values, extent_values_ingredients |
| after | [`measurement.summarize`](../nodes.md) | x=extent_values | summaries=$burst_summaries, combine=each | extent_stats |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE GLOBAL BURSTS of a band: WHEN the cortex is in one, and WHERE (spec docs/specs/2026-11-13-cortical-events.md; the chain of docs/specs/2026-11-17-consolidation.md section 9.1). THE GRAPH:
  recording -- the field chain `cortical_band` (composed: the band read on the cortex through the kernel, the SPATIAL band folded in, |z| per vertex) -->
  reduce {over: the coupled product (spatial tiles at the spatial scale x time tiles of the band), made by `select_product`}: amplitude and envelope_max per CELL -- roll_up {to: whole | pieces}
  --> the TRACE (the largest |z| per time tile: envelope_max merges by max, over the whole brain or each connected piece) -- summarize --> the baseline -- select.events.spans (Rheome's 1.5 / 1.0 SD)
  --> the global bursts (an irregular selection detected over the time grid; no channel) -- select.events.regions (the bursts' space x time EXTENT on the cells) -- reduce.members -- summarize.
Parameters are QUANTITIES: the band (Hz), the spatial scale (a tile diameter, a wavelength or a named scale: its level is resolved in closed form and recorded with the snapped quantity), the
filters of the bursts (a gap to join and a duration range, in seconds or in cycles of the band's centre: "0.1 s", ">=3 cycles"), the extents' area (mm2).
The cortex is the caller's choice: the kernel's surface (the two-hemisphere surface of record) or the glued surface made by `run glue` (the default computational manifold for
spatiotemporal patterns); the bursts and extents are reported on the original hemispheres.

SEVERAL (band x spatial scale) pairs: `--band` and `--spatial-scale` take LISTS; the runner makes one plan per pair, each cached on its own (this replaces `cortical_event_pairs`).
THE EDGES ON SAMPLES (Rheome's rise and fall fit): the per-SAMPLE series of each burst's trace is the largest tile mean per sample, a measurement over the product of the spatial tiles and the one-sample time grid
(`select_product` with the time grid of 4 ms tiles at 250 Hz, the line's samples), rolled over space with `merge: max` (the largest of the members' own values); `select.risefall` fits each burst on it, the fit gate
keeps the bursts that fit well (`bursts_kept`: r2 >= gate_min_r2 and no time at its bound), and the stages (onset, within, offset) come from the stored fits. MEMORY: the sample product's cells, tiles x samples of the span.
WHERE: each burst's space x time EXTENT on the cells of its own time tiles; each cell's amplitude standardised against its spatial tile's baseline over the run's time tiles; hysteresis regions
(`extent_enter_sd` / `extent_exit_sd`) on the graph of touching tiles within a time tile and a tile with itself in the next; every region an EVENT linked to its burst, its measures by the exact
roll-up of its cells (area, amplitude, peak, first and last tile, duration, path length of the centres), with their statistics across the events.

  nxr-neuro run select_dyadic_surface --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --surface cortex --finest "20 mm"
  nxr-neuro run select_time_grid      --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest
  nxr-neuro run global_bursts --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --spatial-scale "wavelength 40 mm" --band "8-16 Hz" --all [--groups pieces --combine each]
```
